payload.reason: The evidence provides specific performance results for various models used in cyberbullying detection, including improvements from oversampling and comparisons between DNN and traditional machine learning models.

claims.text: Oversampling bullying posts improved the performance of DNN models significantly across evaluation measures, particularly for the smallest dataset, Formspring.
DNN models outperformed traditional machine learning models (LR, SVM, RF, NB) in cyberbullying detection, as shown in comparative performance results.
Transfer learning with DNN models showed low recall but higher precision when applied to different datasets, indicating varying nature of cyberbullying.
